runtimeFailure: No qualifying bean of type com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper for CpfDomainCallAutoConfiguration
rootCause: The mandatory Base Runtime carries and consumes Jackson 2 but has no conditional ObjectMapper auto-configuration; Spring Boot 4's Jackson 3 bean is a distinct type.
ownerDecision: Base Runtime owns one conditional Jackson 2 mapper with discovered modules; user-defined Jackson 2 mapper wins and Boot Jackson 3 remains untouched.
